target: Local browser application served on loopback HTTP
readinessObjective: Prove contracts and engine feasibility before the application build
initialProvisioning: Dependency installation and version-matched asset downloads can require internet access. After provisioning, the local server serves all engine, worker, extension, and dataset assets.
runtimeRequirement: A fresh browser session must load and run SQL from localhost with all external origins blocked.
devicePolicy: Use the measured small dataset and bounded execution. The 8 GiB desktop target is guidance, not a tested minimum-device guarantee or a local-readiness blocker.
deferredPublicationConcerns: Exact portrait redistribution and crop permission; user accepts the supplied wiki portrait for now and wants to revisit rights later
Owned public HTTPS hosting and deployed security headers; user chose to keep public deployment blocked
